paragraphs.text: The Child of Alara is a legendary avatar of Alara .

The Child of Alara is an avatar that was spawned by the Maelstrom and is comprised of all colors of mana . The Child looks like a large baby made of energy. It is a manifestation of the Conflux itself and showed no allegiance or mercy to any of the five shards. On its card, when the Child of Alara dies, it destroys all non-land permanents while not allowing them to regenerate . It shows no allegiance or mercy to any of the five shards.
